{{Top|leg}}
'''Altratonne Station''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on the uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Altratonne]]. It was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] relay station that was intended to extend the Empire's communication network throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[792.001/Z6]] and was [[Battle of Altratonne|assaulted]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces under the command of Commander [[Lav Bilsek]].
